answerText: Parking stall widths (e.g., 9'-0") and angles (90°) are dimensioned in one section of the resident parking area. However, stall depths are not dimensioned anywhere on the sheet.

evidence.description: Dimensions showing 9'-0" stall widths and a 90° angle
